svg.title: Graph of p
svg.desc: Coordinate graph of p showing a straight left branch, a filled point at (3, 5), and a curved right branch beginning at an open point at (3, 2). For x < 3, the graph follows y = x + 2. The point (3, 5) is filled. For x > 3, the graph follows y = x² − 7 and has an open point at (3, 2). Arrows indicate continuation beyond the displayed window.
